items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: I bet you T.O. and I bet you Manette would know a lot of them men.

ctx.x: I made my first communion at Carver's Christmas. I was living on St. Anne between Miro and Taunty, 23rd, 18th St. Anne. Anybody who knows these men can make them out. Oh, very good picture, very good picture. I'm sure that T.O. could do. I bet you T.O. and I bet you Manette would know a lot of them men. Yeah, very likely.
Boy, I see Manette would know some of them.
